description:
The best way to do crosswords with ChatGPT. Just ask it to generate a crossword for you- large or small, simple or cryptic- you can even give it a theme!

e.g.

- "Display a crossword I can complete, based on place names"
- "Show the crossword widget with bird names"
- "Give me an interactive cryptic crossword"

defaultPrompt: Show me a crossword with sea creatures
